data.reasoning: The deepseek model successfully audited the PKGBUILD and all other repository files, confirming standard, benign packaging practices with proper upstream sources, SHA-256 checksums, and PGP verification. The qwen model's inconclusive verdict was solely due to a transient API error (HTTP 400) when attempting to audit the PKGBUILD, which carries no verdict signal. There is no evidence of injected malicious code.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is caused by a tool error in the qwen model (HTTP 400 BadRequestError) when auditing the PKGBUILD, leading to an inconclusive result for that file and the overall package. The deepseek model successfully reviewed the PKGBUILD and found it safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit the PKGBUILD due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: When a single file audit fails due to a transient API error, the audit tool should either retry the request or gracefully degrade by relying on other models' successful audits of the same file, rather than forcing an inconclusive package verdict.
